review_conclusion: A1 的 CleanKLS/DLS 口已经从泛泛的大筛缺口压成外部输入登记表：K1--K9 的失败项都回流到 PDEC/SAE/Multiplicity/Promotion，全部通过时才调用 Kloosterman/dispersion 大筛。外部深定理版可在接受窗口化 DI/BFI/Kuznetsov 输入时闭合；完全自足版仍卡在单一 Kuznetsov-LS atom (SC-9)。
structural_law: A1 clean branch is invoked only after all finite signatures, column/tail caps, promotable prime residues, and phase-residue mutual-information peaks have been routed away. Under those K1--K9 admission conditions the residual is a dyadic L2-flat Kloosterman/dispersion formal unit. If a windowed DI/BFI/Kuznetsov large-sieve input is accepted, the clean branch is absorbed. Without external input, the remaining self-contained task is exactly the Kuznetsov-LS atom (SC-9).
